capabilities.summary: Authenticated intent-to-plan-to-grant-to-execution-to-evidence pipeline.
Transactional SHA-256 hash-linked evidence log with restart verification.
Runtime policy stacks merge global-to-user constraints deny-dominantly and require independent approval for every permitted high-risk effect.
Immutable digest-addressed capsule manifests with signature verification, schemas, SBOM digest, and revocation state.
Signed canonical JSONL export supports time, type, object, and capsule scopes plus optional X25519 recipient encryption and independent verification.
Local proposals use human-chamber voting, finalization, timelocked activation, live authority-reducing policy overlays, verification, rollback metadata, expiring emergencies, and appeal records.
Purpose-, scope-, subject-, controller-, expiry-, and revocation-bound consent receipts.
Local Ed25519 node admission, owner and key binding, capability renewal, expiry, and quarantine are enforced; federated discovery remains separate.
Local signed storage offers are bound to active admitted nodes and quarantined with them; object-transfer adapters remain unavailable.
Rootless OCI runtime adapter with digest allowlist and deny-by-default egress is specified but not enabled.
Model provider routing requires an explicitly configured provider capsule.
Content-addressed encrypted memory objects and edges support owner access, consent-scoped selective disclosure, tombstoning, and scoped export.

Signed canonical export bundles can be cryptographically validated, staged with a deterministic record diff, and applied to a provenance-preserving foreign-record store only after independent approval.
Autonomous research/training loops remain disabled until budgets, cancellation, provenance, and evaluation gates are implemented.
Math, physics, cryptography, data, code, web, and research tools use signed provider capsules.
Discord, Slack, Telegram, WhatsApp, X, email, and other channel providers require separate least-privilege adapters.
Marketplace metadata, quarantine, review, trust scoring, and install-without-authority semantics are specified.
DIDs, credentials, selective disclosure, reputation, and portable identity require an approved credential profile.

Independently verifiable admitted-node bundles use contiguous dependency-checked version vectors, replay and equivocation rejection, visible concurrent heads, and explicit complete conflict resolution.
Federated discovery, capability-aware scheduling, resource balancing, adaptive roles, renewal, and quarantine are specified.

Encrypted signed Grid snapshots support tamper detection, stopped-Grid exact-digest restore, signed policy-derived retention into recoverable quarantine, interruption recovery, and recurring restore evidence.
Education runs as a strict-consent capsule; curriculum and learner systems are not part of the trusted kernel.
Health runs as a strict-consent capsule and requires clinical/regulatory governance.
Public-service workflows require jurisdiction-specific identity, appeal, records, and legal controls.
Business and financial workflows require audited accounting and settlement adapters.
Timelocked activation, rollback, authority-reducing expiring emergencies, protected recovery actions, mandatory review records, and appeals run locally; portable delegation remains specified.
Task markets, autonomous workforce, payroll, and digital legacy are disabled pending accounting, identity, dispute, inheritance, and labor-policy controls.
Embodied execution is denied until device-specific safety, approval, geofence, force, and halt controls are audited.
Local accounting uses owner- and unit-bound accounts with transactional balanced double-entry journals and safe integer amounts; external settlement remains disabled.
AXM, bonds, rewards, treasury, bridges, and liquidity remain disabled pending reconciled policy, tests, deployment evidence, and external audit.
A proof is accepted only with a named circuit, verification key, public-input schema, and verifier adapter.
Authenticated operator API for intent submission, status, audit, recovery, and governed state inspection.
Command-line operator client with explicit input validation and fail-closed API error handling.
A browser operator dashboard is specified but is not part of the supported runtime.

Bounded-cardinality service telemetry, dependency-aware readiness, authenticated operational reports, OpenMetrics output, and static integrity/security alerts cover the four-process runtime without exposing sensitive labels.
A digest-pinned non-root container package is statically release-gated, passes the four-process host drill, and is built and exercised through the published composed readiness workflow.
Release tooling, observability, and container verification are executable; legacy installer replacement, external alert delivery, and independently evidenced live deployment remain incomplete.
